battery.analysis: Observed Temperature raw 3389 gives /100 = 33.89 °C and Smart Battery 0.1 K = 65.75 °C; both pass the broad sanity range. LifetimeData.MaximumTemperature raw 40 is not assumed to share the same unit. If it means 40 °C, /100 is internally more consistent (33.89 ≤ 40) while 0.1 K would exceed it (65.75 > 40). If the lifetime field uses another unit, this is only supporting evidence, not a unit contract. The report preserves /100, Smart Battery 0.1 K, tenths-Celsius and integer-Celsius candidates without selecting or clamping one. HID battery correlation supports /100 for this device: gas gauge battery (difference 0.89 °C), gas gauge battery (difference 0.19 °C), gas gauge battery (difference 0.89 °C), gas gauge battery (difference 0.01 °C), gas gauge battery (difference 0.01 °C), gas gauge battery (difference 0.01 °C).
